theorems.name: Submission.dmcbr_ci_bl_pairing_tendsto
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (νs : ℕ → Measure (Euclid P)) (ν : Measure (Euclid P)) (τs : ℕ → Euclid P → MultiVector P n) (ζ₀ : MultiVector P n) (w : Euclid P → Covector (Euclid P) n), (∀ (k : ℕ) (K : Set (Euclid P)), IsCompact K → νs k K < ∞) → (∀ f : Euclid P → ℝ, Continuous f → HasCompactSupport f → Tendsto (fun k => ∫ x, f x ∂(νs k)) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x, f x ∂ν))) → (∀ k, AEStronglyMeasurable (τs k) (νs k)) → (∀ R : ℝ, 0 < R → Tendsto (fun k => ∫⁻ x in closedBall (0 : Euclid P) R, ‖τs k x - ζ₀‖ₑ ∂(νs k)) atTop (𝓝 0)) → Continuous w → HasCompactSupport w → Tendsto (fun k => ∫ x, τs k x (w x) ∂(νs k)) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x, ζ₀ (w x) ∂ν))
